title: Background scan state (MCP scan_status)
description: Result of the MCP tool scan_status, and of scan with background true: the state of the scan started in the background and, once it has ended, its summary.

state.description: idle: no background scan was started in this session; failed: it ended with an error (error) and saved nothing

summary.description: When done: the scan's summary (schema mcp-scan)
